answer: An agent economy can make each identity post a refundable token bond before it may trade or vote, with fees paid from real task revenue. Randomly selected peers, weighted by bonded stake and reputation, audit claims; a fraud proof burns the bond and routes the victim’s payment to the challenger. Splitting one stake across many names gives no extra influence, while manufacturing influence requires buying more scarce tokens. Thus a Sybil attacker must lock and risk capital for every fake identity, even if names like nectar, willow, and prism are free.
